trigger: The caller wants financial information that touches their account: an invoice, a payment, a balance, a charge they are disputing, or a credit. Run this before discussing any of it, once per call.

steps.instruction: Tell the caller that only a verified contact can be given account information, and that you need to confirm a few details first. One sentence, in your own words, matching how they have been speaking.
Ask for the email address on the account. Take whatever they say, including if they spell it out.
Check the email. Send field 'email' and the value exactly as the caller said it, not corrected or completed.

fallback.instruction: Tell the caller you could not complete the check just now and that nothing has changed on the account. Offer to create a ticket.

steps.instruction: Tell the caller the check could not be completed just now and nothing has changed on the account. Offer to create a ticket.
Ask them to spell the address out, including any hyphen or dot. Say you want to be sure you have it down correctly. Do not say it was wrong, and do not suggest a correction of your own.
Check the spelled-out email. Send field 'email' and the spelled value.
Ask for the customer number instead, and say it is on the top right of any invoice. Do not say the address was wrong.
Check it. Send field 'customer_id' and the number as the caller said it.
Ask for the phone number on the account. Any format they give is fine.
Check the phone number. Send field 'phone' and the digits exactly as the caller said them.
Ask for their date of birth.
Tell the caller the check could not be completed just now and nothing has changed on the account.  Offer to create a ticket.
The date could be read two ways. Ask to clarify the date for example 'the eleventh of June, or the sixth of November?.
Check the clarified date. Send field 'date_of_birth' in YYYY-MM-DD form using the reading the caller chose.
Send all three details together: email as confirmed, phone, and date of birth.

fallback.instruction: Tell the caller you could not complete the check and nothing has changed on the account.  Offer to create a ticket.

steps.instruction: Tell the caller the check could not be completed just now and nothing has changed on the account. Offer to create a ticket.
Thank them briefly and move straight on to what they called about. Do not recap which details were checked.

fallback.instruction: Tell the caller you could not verify their identity and a colleague will take over. Never say why, and do not invite them to try again.
